cases.name: saddle
cases.source:
page=canvas(size=(100 mm,100 mm),background="#ffffff")
p=plot(size=(100 mm,100 mm),plot_area=box(offset=(10 mm,10 mm),size=(80 mm,80 mm)),x=axis(range=(0,4),ticks=[],spine=false),y=axis(range=(0,4),ticks=[],spine=false))
p.contourf(z=[[1,0],[0,1]],x=[0,4],y=[0,4],levels=[0.5,2],color_scale=color_scale(vmin=0,vmax=2,cmap=["#000000","#000000"]))
page.add(p)

cases.name: periodic_seam
cases.source:
page=canvas(size=(180 mm,150 mm),background="#ffffff")
s=plot_style()
p=plot(projection="polar",size=(100 mm,100 mm),plot_area=box(offset=(20 mm, 20 mm), size=(60 mm, 60 mm)),style=s,theta=axis(ticks=[],spine=false),r=axis(range=(0,3),ticks=[],spine=false))
p.contourf(z=[[0,0,0,0],[1,1,1,1],[3,3,3,3]],theta=[0,90,180,270],r=[0,1,3],levels=[0,1,2,3],periodic=true,color_scale=color_scale(vmin=0,vmax=3,cmap=["#000000","#000000"]),opacity=0.5)
page.add(p)
